name: Erlotinib
mechanism: Reversible ATP-competitive EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor with greater potency against sensitising EGFR mutants than wild-type receptor.
monitoring: Evaluation of new respiratory symptoms for ILD
interactions: Cigarette smoking induces CYP1A2 and lowers exposure. Acid-reducing agents reduce absorption. CYP3A4 inducers and inhibitors alter exposure. Monitor INR with warfarin.
resistance: Acquired T790M mutation, MET amplification, HER2 amplification and histological transformation.
